race.comment: LIGHT FILLED (6) brings the most appealing profile after ending her previous campaign with a Donald third on heavy ground, beaten just under two lengths as a well-supported favourite, and a Ballarat fourth when close in an open market. That form should stack up well here. PARAK (3) resumes off a Colac trial win and his Swan Hill fourth reads well enough after racing wide throughout and finishing within just under three lengths at big odds. Can improve. CRACKED IT (4) has the fitness pointer of two trial wins since last racing and has placed at both tries around 1000m. Has the ability to figure prominently. HE'S FIERCE (1) was plain first-up at Traralgon but should improve off that and has claims with INNER THOUGHTS (5) who did beat him home there.
